characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Open, dissipative, stochastic, non-Markovian, and time-directed formation is allowed.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Exchange/noise balance, retarded response, and separation of write transients from the retained post-closure state.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: The candidate gravity sector is causal, passive, and stable; unexplained gain, advanced response, and inherited write latency are absent.

characteristics.characteristic_name: Relational dynamical geometry and background independence
characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Non-geometric algebra, lattice, medium, preferred coordinates, or an already geometric carrier are allowed.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Relational intervals, transport, dimension, substrate dependence, and multi-network consistency.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: One dynamical source-responsive geometry predicts invariant rods, clocks, trajectories, and signals without unresolved fixed-substrate artifacts.

characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Heterogeneous, carrier-specific, probe-specific, or zero microscopic couplings are allowed.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Scale flow of normalized coupling spread across source, probe, carrier, state, and location.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: One effective coupling and the declared equivalence and local-invariance limits hold in the endpoint domain.

characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Record count, provenance, chemistry, stress, retained energy, topology, and correlations may affect microdynamics; none is automatically gravitational charge.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Joint operator mixing, full material controls, source-composition swaps, binding/exchange accounting, and ancestry of the eventual source role.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: A carrier-independent effective source appropriate to the endpoint is earned; record labels alone do not change the law at fixed full source and boundary conditions.

characteristics.characteristic_name: Conservation, Ward identities, and Bianchi closure
characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: An open record subsystem may exchange energy-momentum; probability conservation and record lineage remain distinct.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Closed-enlargement exchange balance, transported approximately conserved modes, direct/sequential conservation, and Ward-residual flow.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: Diffeomorphism Ward identities, covariant total conservation, and Bianchi closure hold without a fitted repair tensor.

characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Zero, contact, screened, gapped, critical, topological, long-range, or explicitly nonlocal response is allowed.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Gap and correlation-length flow, pole and residue continuity, finite-size and range tests, or an exposed no-go escape.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: Massless long-range static and dynamic response has one common normalization in the claimed domain.

characteristics.characteristic_name: Static constrained sector and radiative helicity two
characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: No microscopic spin label is required; scalar, vector, and tensor operators may mix before a symmetry group is earned.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Operational rotations or Lorentz structure, mode continuity, constraint/radiative separation, pole and residue tests, and ghost tests.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: The static tidal constraint sector and exactly two positive-energy on-shell helicity-two modes share their coupling and Ward structure.

characteristics.characteristic_name: One metric and common causal cone
characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Multiple speeds, diffusion, anisotropy, or no metric representation is allowed.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Convergence of time-of-flight, dispersion, orientation, and independent-probe reconstructions.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: Clocks, light, matter, mechanical bodies, and gravity reconstruct one Lorentzian metric and cone within declared corrections.

characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Linear, nonlinear, saturating, screened, or nonadditive microscopic response is allowed.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Connected multi-intervention responses and vertex/Ward transport across scale.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: The same effective action, coupling, and gauge identities determine linear response and higher-source or self-response.

characteristics.characteristic_name: Attractive weak-field sign and positive-energy stability
characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Attraction, repulsion, frustration, screening, and sign-changing response are allowed.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Sign and residue flow, source reversal, spectral positivity, and stability diagnostics.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: Ordinary positive nonrelativistic sources have the observed attractive weak limit and physical radiative poles are positive and stable.

characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Zero-, one-, two-, or three-dimensional, graph, hierarchical, topological, or microscopically nonlocal carriers are allowed.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Spectral and relational dimension, causal support, chart overlap, falloff, and dispersion flow.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: Three operational spatial dimensions plus time, causal or quasilocal propagation, and bounded higher-derivative or nonlocal corrections hold over the claimed window.

characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Preferred time, a formation arrow, anisotropy, and nonrelativistic microdynamics are allowed.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: Preferred-frame, boost, rotation, dispersion, and birefringence residual flow.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: Effective diffeomorphism redundancy and local Lorentz behavior hold in matter and gravity sectors within frozen bounds.

characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Carrier geometry, mechanism, coefficient, and crossover location may differ microscopically.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: An unchanged operator grammar and composition law across held-out scales and distinct surfaces, converging without material-name branches.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: One limiting endpoint action and constants apply in a common infrared domain without carrier-specific science laws.

characteristics.allowed_micro_behavior: Record entropy, erasure heat, and boundary scaling may occur without gravity.
characteristics.intermediate_discriminators: For a horizon-complete claim, horizon and boundary observables must use the already earned geometry and coupling.
characteristics.ir_endpoint_requirement: Horizon entropy, temperature, first law, and boundary charges close with the same endpoint constants.
